title: AutoLoop authority record — immutable projection of human/policy authority

canonicalDependencyPath.description: AURACORE-AUTOLOOP-C5B-ATOMIC-EVIDENCE-SCHEMA-PARITY-AND-CANONICAL-TEST-RUNNER-1: identical definition to card-input.schema.json's canonicalDependencyPath — one grammar, reused by $ref in both schema files, mirrored by validate-role-artifacts.mjs isCanonicalDependencyPath() at runtime. Persisted evidence must never accept a path form that card-input rejects.

structuredCommandId.description: Mirrors run-card.mjs REQUIRED_COMMAND_ID_PATTERN exactly (author-declared structured id — never derived from array position or command text). The colon character is not in this alphabet, so a structured id can never collide lexically with the internal-only synthesized legacy execution id form 'legacy:<index>'.

risk.description: Already normalized via risk-normalization.mjs before this record is constructed. No alias values accepted here.

mode.description: Mirrors run-card.mjs VALID_MODES (STANDARD_MODES + LIFECYCLE_ONLY_MODES) exactly — not a new mode taxonomy.

required_commands.description: AURACORE-AUTOLOOP-C5B1: canonical digest-bound projection of card.validation.required_commands — see run-card.mjs requiredCommandsForDigest(). Legacy string entries have id:null (confirmed against requiredCommandsForDigest's actual mapping — NOT the synthesized internal-only 'legacy:<index>' execution id used solely by planRequiredCommands/executeRequiredCommandPlan, which is never persisted into the authority record). Exactly two dependency scopes exist: 'global' (repository-wide) and 'paths' (path-scoped).

allOf.description: Legacy source: id is always null (requiredCommandsForDigest's actual mapping — never the internal-only synthesized 'legacy:<index>' execution id), scope is always 'global', paths is always empty — the exact shape normalizeRequiredCommand() always produces for a legacy string entry.

Structured source: id is always a non-null author-declared string matching the structured-id grammar (never null, never the ':'-containing legacy execution-id form, which this pattern's alphabet cannot produce).

ingress_identity.description: Where this authority originated: manual/<actor>, producer/<generation_id>, emergency/<actor>, etc.

approval_metadata.description: Null unless ingress requires explicit human approval (e.g. READ_ONLY emergency bypass).

start_head.description: Exact starting HEAD. Required, never optional.

worktree_identity.description: From collectFingerprint(). May be empty only for legacy/unit-constructed records; real-model dispatch requires a real repository (see run-card.mjs main() gates).

git_common_dir_identity.description: Resolved --git-common-dir, from collectFingerprint(). Detects common-dir/worktree rebinding at repair-round drift checks.

origin_url.description: git remote get-url origin, from collectFingerprint(). Empty string permitted for local repos with no remote (dry-run/test compatibility) — real-model dispatch requires this to be non-empty (see run-card.mjs main()).

origin_master.description: git rev-parse origin/master, from collectFingerprint(). Empty string permitted for local repos with no origin/master ref — real-model dispatch requires this to be non-empty (see run-card.mjs main()).

expected_worktree_state.description: "clean" or a status-only dirty digest, from collectFingerprint(). Not compared for equality during repair-round drift checks (requireClean:false there by design) — captured for audit only.

captured_at.description: Excluded from the authority semantic digest — mutable-in-spirit bookkeeping, not authority content.

authority_digest.description: sha256 of the canonical serialization of this record minus captured_at and authority_digest itself.
